solver.algorithm_claim: prefix search with bounded exact-state lowest-J labels; shadow available

state_merge.child_denominator: nonterminal children after original J pruning, before guide
state_merge.payload_definition: retained actual_xy and weights bytes; excludes Python overhead
state_merge.timing_note: lookup_s includes key_build_s; all index work is in the solver budget
state_merge.shadow_scope: opportunities in the unpruned run, not a predicted active saving

solver.guide_role: unchanged coarse-cell ordering only; neither guide nor completion is a bound
solver.pruning_rule: original accumulated-J prune plus optional exact-state lowest-J labels
solver.initial_route_generation_cost: external historical route; copy and original physical replay included

initial_score.J_time_scaled_interpretation: fixed-clock post-observation sum, not exact continuous-time MTTD
initial_score.waypoint_semantics: motion commands; a terminal partial edge may not reach its last waypoint

best.J_time_scaled_interpretation: fixed-clock post-observation sum, not exact continuous-time MTTD
best.waypoint_semantics: motion commands; a terminal partial edge may not reach its last waypoint

solver.timing_note: completion_s includes its transition, replay and archive subcomponents; do not add twice

cache_statistics.byte_counter_scope: retained ndarray payload only; use sampled RSS for total memory
cache_statistics.fixed_scalar_cache: original horizon, tick count and time tolerance values
cache_statistics.scope: fresh caches inside one charged solve; no cross-run reuse

diagnostics.first_time_scope: new generated/replayed candidates only; supplied initial route excluded
diagnostics.snapshot_scope: maintained histogram counters, no full-heap scans; all sampling is charged

solver.archive_scope: encountered_replayed_only; J pruning can hide other nondominated routes
solver.archive_limit_policy: preserve first overflow point and stop, never silently truncate

physical_replay.J_time_scaled_interpretation: fixed-clock post-observation sum, not exact continuous-time MTTD
physical_replay.waypoint_semantics: motion commands; a terminal partial edge may not reach its last waypoint
